title: Interactive travel form
source:
root = Stack([card])
card = Card([heading, intro, tripForm])
heading = CardHeader("Plan a weekend", "An interactive form rendered by the official OpenUI web library")
intro = TextContent("Enter your details, then ask the assistant to plan a trip. These are the stock OpenUI components.")
tripForm = Form("trip", buttons, [travelerField, emailField])
travelerField = FormControl("Traveler", Input("traveler", "Your name", "text", {required: true, minLength: 2}), "Who is travelling?")
emailField = FormControl("Email", Input("email", "you@example.com", "email", {required: true, email: true}), "Used only in the example's action data")
buttons = Buttons([submit, docs], "row")
submit = Button("Plan trip", @ToAssistant("Plan my weekend", {viewId: "trip-form", itineraryId: "TRIP-042", source: "openui-proof"}), "primary")
docs = Button("OpenUI docs", @OpenUrl("https://www.openui.com/docs/openui-lang"), "secondary")

title: Cards and data table
source:
root = Stack([summaryCard, detailsCard, followupCard], "column", "l")
summaryCard = Card([summaryHeading, summaryText, tags])
summaryHeading = CardHeader("Project overview", "A richer card layout with the official column-oriented table")
summaryText = TextContent("The prototype keeps Markdown native and hosts this OpenUI tree as one child.")
tags = TagBlock(["macOS", "TextKit 2", "OpenUI"], "md")
detailsCard = Card([tableHeading, statusTable])
tableHeading = CardHeader("Workstreams", "All values below come from the fixture source")
statusTable = Table([Col("Workstream", workstreams), Col("Owner", owners), Col("Progress", progress, "number")])
workstreams = ["Native document", "Hosted child", "Action bridge", "Visual review"]
owners = ["Pico", "OpenUI", "App", "Team"]
progress = [100, 100, 85, 60]
followupCard = Card([Callout("info", "Selection", "Copying the outer child should export this OpenUI program, not a screenshot."), Buttons([explain], "row")])
explain = Button("Explain status", @ToAssistant("Explain the project status", {viewId: "status-card", reportId: 42}), "primary")

title: Chart and follow-up action
source:
root = Stack([chartCard])
chartCard = Card([heading, description, revenue, Buttons([explain], "row")])
heading = CardHeader("Q4 revenue", "Official OpenUI BarChart with two series")
description = TextContent("A vector chart, ordinary web controls and the same semantic action callback.")
revenue = BarChart(labels, [productA, productB], "grouped", "Month", "Revenue", 260)
labels = ["October", "November", "December"]
productA = Series("Product A", [120, 150, 180])
productB = Series("Product B", [90, 110, 140])
explain = Button("Explain chart", @ToAssistant("Explain this revenue chart", {viewId: "revenue-chart", period: "Q4"}), "primary")
